, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely assumed the answer was “John Clark” based on The Sum of All Fears (2002) without verifying the question’s intent. The 2002 film centers on Tom Clancy’s character Jack Ryan (portrayed by Ben Affleck), and the trivia-style phrasing “fictional character created by Tom Clancy turned into a film in 2002” points to Jack Ryan, not the supporting character John Clark. This initial misinterpretation led the plan to fixate on confirming the wrong character.
